生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided RIVEN, ALLY SOLDIER, SOLDIERS, ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE, HOME VILLAGE / VALLEY, and previous Scene 22 final-frame references.

Keep the exact same Riven identity, face, pale-blonde hair, clothing, armor details, body proportions, and sword established in the previous scenes.

Keep Ally Soldier exactly consistent with his reference and the previous final frame.

Ally Soldier has just died and remains motionless on the ground.

Keep the surrounding soldiers consistent with the soldiers established in the previous battle.

IMPORTANT SPATIAL CONTINUITY:

Riven, Ally Soldier, and the remaining soldiers are currently on the elevated mountain road / hillside outside the valley.

Riven's home village is FAR AWAY below them in the valley.

The village must NOT appear close to Riven.

From this elevated position, the burning village should appear distant and relatively small beneath the enormous surrounding mountains.

Large columns of dark smoke rise from the distant valley.

=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Late-afternoon mountain atmosphere.

Natural human movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement and cuts.

Large realistic sense of distance and scale.

No background music.

No subtitles.

Dialogue is in English.

Use natural sound:

mountain wind,
distant fire,
Riven's breathing,
soldiers' footsteps,
armor movement,
and distant low sounds echoing through the valley.

No combat occurs in this scene.

Do not reveal the mysterious dark presence yet.

=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Continue immediately after Ally Soldier's death.

Riven slowly stands beside Ally's body.

The surviving soldiers who had just been fighting Riven react to her movement and cautiously step backward.

They are retreating from Riven because they have just witnessed how dangerous she is.

At first, their reaction has nothing to do with the distant village.

Then a powerful distant sound echoes from far below in the valley.

Everyone turns toward Riven's burning home village.

A separate group of soldiers can already be seen retreating along the distant road from the direction of the village.

They are moving away from the valley in disorder.

As they approach, their panic becomes clear.

The remaining soldiers around Riven realize something has happened below and begin leaving as well.

Riven watches them retreat.

Then she looks back toward the distant burning village and suddenly remembers that her father is still there.

She calls for him and runs in the opposite direction from the soldiers:

down the mountain road toward her burning home.

=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — RIVEN STANDS

Begin from a new cinematic angle rather than recreating the exact final close-up from Scene 22.

Place the camera low behind Riven.

Ally Soldier lies motionless in the near foreground, slightly out of focus.

Riven is beside him.

The surviving soldiers remain farther around them on the mountain road.

Riven slowly rises to her feet.

She looks down at Ally one final time.

No dialogue.

Keep the moment restrained.

Then Riven lifts her head.

The soldiers immediately react.

One soldier cautiously steps backward.

Another follows.

Several soldiers keep their weapons ready while slowly increasing their distance from Riven.

Their attention is still on Riven.

They are backing away because of her.

Riven notices them.

She turns slightly toward the soldiers.

Nobody attacks.

For a brief moment, both sides simply watch each other.

Then—

a deep distant sound rolls across the valley.

BOOM.

It comes from very far away.

Riven turns her head toward the valley.

The soldiers also look toward the sound.

Transition naturally toward the distant landscape.

Far below them lies Riven's home village.

The village is very distant.

Large dark smoke columns rise high into the sky above the valley.

Small areas of orange fire are visible far below.

The enormous mountain landscape should emphasize how far away the village actually is.

Another distant low sound echoes through the valley.

Riven watches.

Then movement becomes visible along the long mountain road leading upward from the valley.

=== Shot 2 — SOLDIERS FROM THE VALLEY ===

Use a long-lens cinematic view down the mountain road.

Far away, several small human figures are already moving quickly uphill from the direction of the burning village.

They gradually become recognizable as SOLDIERS.

They are retreating from the valley.

They are not marching in formation.

Their spacing is irregular.

Some carry their equipment loosely while moving quickly.

They repeatedly look behind them toward the distant village.

Cut back closer to Riven and the soldiers around her.

Everyone watches the approaching group.

The retreating soldiers continue uphill.

As they come close enough to communicate, one frightened soldier shouts toward the others:

"RUN!"

He continues past without stopping.

More soldiers follow him.

The soldiers who had been facing Riven exchange uncertain looks.

Their attention shifts completely away from Riven.

One turns and begins retreating uphill.

The others quickly follow.

Soon the same soldiers who had just been fighting Riven are moving away with the retreating group.

Riven does not follow them.

=== Shot 3 — FATHER ===

Hold on Riven as soldiers move past her and continue uphill, away from the valley.

Ally remains behind her on the ground.

Riven watches the soldiers leave.

Their footsteps and armor gradually move farther away.

Then Riven slowly turns back toward the valley.

Show her point of view.

Far below:

her home village is still burning beneath the enormous columns of smoke.

Hold briefly.

Riven's expression suddenly changes.

She remembers.

Her father is still down there.

Quietly, almost to herself:

"Father..."

Riven stares at the distant village.

Then urgency takes over.

She calls much louder:

"FATHER!"

Riven immediately starts running downhill.

The soldiers are moving uphill away from the valley.

Riven runs in the opposite direction.

Follow behind Riven as she accelerates down the mountain road.

End with a wide cinematic composition:

the retreating soldiers moving away from the valley,

Riven alone running down toward it,

and the distant burning village beneath the towering columns of smoke.

Riven continues toward her home.

CUT.、16:9
